claim_boundary: Measured frozen native binary on one local workload/machine; complete full43 regression and independent bounded fixture acceptance. Individual regressions, short-call tradeoffs and pinned provider allocation gaps remain. No whole-PERF/CG closure or engine-superiority claim.

control_ingest.scope: Control ingest only; candidate changes query consumers and do not claim new ingest measurements.

initial_unretained_candidate.scope: Initial frozen candidate 2afc1530 versus corrected control c71a558e. This analysis records observed tradeoffs; it is not a retention decision or a global performance gain claim. A control repeat and targeted regression follow-up are separate evidence.

methodology.full43_timing_boundary: native process creation through completed public CLI output and process exit
methodology.full43_ordering: Control suite completed earlier than candidate suite; these full43 timings are not alternating paired samples. All three recorded native-process runs are included; no full43 run is labeled a warmup.
methodology.full43_correctness: complete returned values compared with retained ShardLoom outputs; not an independent oracle
methodology.full43_complete_result_checks: 129/129 for each variant against retained ShardLoom references; independent fixture evidence is separate below.
methodology.ratios: Full43 ratios are candidate/control (above 1 is slower); heldout paired ratios are baseline/candidate (above 1 favors candidate), matching its original summary.
methodology.source_sha256_provenance: Source checksum is copied from the small control-artifact manifest, not rehashed from the 18.6GB artifact during this read-only analysis.
methodology.uncertainty: Observed sample spread only; uncontrolled OS cache, separate suite times, three samples per query, no confidence interval or throughput/scaling inference from heldout fixture.

counter_semantics.coverage: Absent counters remain absent in per-run evidence. Totals sum only reported records; coverage is explicit, and missing fields are not measured zeros.
counter_semantics.numeric_rows: Sum of rows presented to native numeric accessor calls, including repeated columns/passes; not unique source rows.
counter_semantics.native_decode_calls: Reported native Primitive execution/accessor calls. Does not prove every call performs decompression, nor that provider work is zero-decode.
counter_semantics.typed_value_bytes_copied: Explicit adapter numeric payload-copy bytes on the observed route; candidate zero excludes dictionary gather copies and does not imply zero copying in filters, validity, providers or other operators.
counter_semantics.array_nbytes_estimates: Reported source/canonical Array.nbytes estimates, nonunique and nonadditive across sharing/repeated calls; not allocation ownership, hardware traffic, allocator reservations or RSS.
counter_semantics.decode_and_typed_copy_nanos: Legacy inclusive accessor span: control native execution plus typed copy; candidate native execution plus owner setup. Provider/filter/validity work may allocate outside HostAllocator. Not isolated copy/decompression CPU time.
counter_semantics.entry_credit_limit: Committed entries plus outstanding block reservations never exceed the distinct-entry limit; table/arena byte admission remains independent.
counter_semantics.entry_credit_claim_calls: Successful block claims, not new groups. Maximum 1024 entries; claims shrink to available credits and remaining partition work.
counter_semantics.entry_credit_granted_entries: Total entry credits granted over the operation, including credits later refunded and potentially granted again.
counter_semantics.entry_credit_return_calls: RAII block returns after use, partition exit, failure or cancellation; each publishes used credits and refunds unused credits.
counter_semantics.entry_credit_refunded_entries: Unused entry credits returned. After drain, granted minus refunded equals committed complete groups and reserved must be zero.
counter_semantics.entry_credit_wait_calls: Condition-variable wait attempts including timed/spurious wakes, not distinct workers, logical contention events or elapsed time. Waiting happens without partition locks or unused credits.
counter_semantics.complete_groups: Published used-entry count is a lower bound while blocks are active, exact after drain, and preserved after storage release.
counter_semantics.partition_equality_comparisons: Actual byte comparisons on matching hashes, including rechecks after releasing the partition lock for credits; concurrent schedules need not have identical counts.
counter_semantics.partition_comparison_publish_calls: Nonzero local comparison counter flushes at partition/refill/error boundaries; no per-key shared counter update.
counter_semantics.worker_and_partition_nanos: Summed potentially overlapping wall service spans; worker busy includes waits, caller joins overlap worker activity, and these are not additive CPU or exclusive elapsed phases.
counter_semantics.memory: native_peak_rss_bytes is process high-water RSS; worker shared reservation peaks are admitted memory capacity, not RSS or proof of all provider allocations.
counter_semantics.control_credit_absence: The control has no block-credit counters. Its per-new-key atomic entry admission and shared comparison updates are source observations, not synthetic measured counter values.

predeclared_control_best_under_1_second.selection_rule: Strict control per-query best < 1.0 second, evaluated only from frozen corrected control; no candidate-dependent selection.

case_definitions.name: nullable_numeric_scalar
case_definitions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(optional_units) AS present, SUM(optional_units) AS total, AVG(optional_units) AS average, MIN(optional_units) AS smallest, MAX(optional_units) AS largest FROM heldout

case_definitions.name: exact_integer_extrema
case_definitions.sql: SELECT MIN(exact_identifier) AS smallest, MAX(exact_identifier) AS largest FROM heldout

case_definitions.name: scalar_distinct
case_definitions.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT category_text) AS labels, COUNT(DISTINCT optional_text) AS optional_labels, COUNT(DISTINCT unique_text) AS unique_labels FROM heldout

case_definitions.name: numeric_group_sum
case_definitions.sql: SELECT cohort_code, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(metric_units) AS total FROM heldout GROUP BY cohort_code

case_definitions.name: skewed_string_count
case_definitions.sql: SELECT category_text, COUNT(*) AS n FROM heldout GROUP BY category_text

case_definitions.name: nullable_string_count
case_definitions.sql: SELECT optional_text, COUNT(*) AS n FROM heldout GROUP BY optional_text

case_definitions.name: composite_group
case_definitions.sql: SELECT cohort_code, category_text, COUNT(*) AS n FROM heldout GROUP BY cohort_code, category_text

case_definitions.name: nullable_group_distinct
case_definitions.sql: SELECT cohort_code, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT optional_text) AS different FROM heldout GROUP BY cohort_code

case_definitions.name: utf8_byte_length
case_definitions.sql: SELECT cohort_code, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(length(category_text)) AS bytes_total FROM heldout WHERE category_text <> '' GROUP BY cohort_code

case_definitions.name: all_unique_group_topk
case_definitions.sql: SELECT unique_text, COUNT(*) AS n FROM heldout GROUP BY unique_text ORDER BY n DESC, unique_text ASC LIMIT 12

case_definitions.name: filtered_sort_offset
case_definitions.sql: SELECT row_key, metric_units, optional_text, exact_identifier FROM heldout WHERE metric_units >= 5 AND cohort_code < 2 ORDER BY metric_units DESC, row_key ASC LIMIT 12 OFFSET 3

case_definitions.name: nullable_projection
case_definitions.sql: SELECT optional_text, exact_identifier, row_key FROM heldout WHERE row_key >= 4084

case_definitions.name: empty_numeric_scalar
case_definitions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(optional_units) AS present, SUM(optional_units) AS total, AVG(optional_units) AS average, MIN(optional_units) AS smallest, MAX(optional_units) AS largest FROM heldout WHERE row_key >= 4096

case_definitions.name: empty_filtered_sort
case_definitions.sql: SELECT row_key, optional_text FROM heldout WHERE row_key >= 4096 ORDER BY row_key ASC LIMIT 12

case_definitions.name: checked_signed_group_overflow
case_definitions.sql: SELECT exact_identifier - 1 AS shifted, COUNT(*) AS n FROM heldout GROUP BY shifted
